title: Design System: Vietnamese Gospel Outreach Ministry New England

panel-strong.note: The logo wash at full strength. Ink text only.

panel.note: Nav bar, empty states, date blocks, quote panels.

background.note: Lavender 10% over white. The page. Never pure white.

foreground.note: Magenta 20% into near-black. Body copy and the hero band.

colorMeta.note: Palette is the VGOMNE logo verbatim: five brand values, every neutral a mix of one of them with white or near-black. No tonal ramps are derived; tints are color-mix() of a token over --surface at the point of use.

display.purpose: Hero and page titles; Playfair 700, fluid clamp size.

body.purpose: Geist sans; minimum 16px on marketing blocks; 1.75 line-height.

shadows.name: elevation-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every card. Two layers: tight contact shadow plus wide ambient. Dark mode uses near-black at high alpha because magenta-tinted low-alpha is invisible on #17101a.

shadows.name: elevation-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for interactive cards only, paired with translateY(-3px). Must be raised alongside elevation-card: the effect is carried by the gap between the two levels, not by either value alone.

motion.name: ease-page-entry
motion.purpose: PageTransition fade and card lift; disabled when prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: card-lift-distance
motion.purpose: How far a card rises on hover. Small on purpose: the shadow carries the effect, the travel only confirms it.

motion.name: duration-card-lift
motion.purpose: Faster on approach than on release, so the rise reads as a reaction and the settle as the card relaxing back down.

components.name: Primary button (on dark hero)
components.description: Deep magenta fill, white label, dark magenta on hover; used for primary hero CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #8e1d5f; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-hero-primary:hover { background: #850050; } .ds-btn-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost button (on dark hero)
components.description: Outline white, transparent fill; secondary hero CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-hero-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); } .ds-btn-hero-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Post card
components.description: Warm surface, 14px radius, border, resting shadow, rises 3px on hover.

components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 760px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid #d6d1fc; background: #ffffff; color: #2c1323; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(142, 29, 95, 0.06), 0 8px 24px -8px rgba(142, 29, 95, 0.16); transition: box-shadow 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(142, 29, 95, 0.08), 0 18px 40px -10px rgba(142, 29, 95, 0.24); transform: translateY(-3px); transition-duration: 200ms; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-card { transition: none; } .ds-card:hover { transform: none; } } .ds-card-inner { padding: 20px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(142, 29, 95, 0.12); color: #8e1d5f; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; margin: 8px 0 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.75; color: #2c1323; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: This system is built for members glancing at phones and laptops at home after work, or catching up on Sunday between services: clean white fields, the logo's deep magenta as the single confident accent for action, mid magenta where a second voice is needed (events, admin hints), and the logo's lavender for panels and dividers. Darkness lives in the hero band only (#1c1a18, the ink neutral), like a quiet coffee shop interior, not a full-site dark theme. Typography does the identity work: Playfair carries headlines and card titles; Geist carries UI, body, and labels.
keyCharacteristics: White (#ffffff) page field; ink (#1c1a18) body copy; deep magenta (#8e1d5f) for all primary interactive emphasis.
Hero is type-only (no photography): radial rose glow + thin rose-to-magenta rule at the foot of the hero.
Cards float, everything else is flat: cards carry a resting shadow and rise 3px on hover; panels, alerts, and section blocks never cast one.
System prefers-color-scheme: dark uses warm charcoal surfaces, never blue-gray chrome.

rules.name: The One Magenta Rule
rules.body: Deep magenta is the only hue that may signal click here or primary navigation emphasis. If a control reads as interactive, it must not be navy, gray, or cold blue.

rules.name: The Rose Is Quiet Rule
rules.body: #de718e may ornament lines, glows, gradients, and hover states; it does not run small white-on-rose text.

rules.name: The Serif Owns Headlines Rule
rules.body: Any element that is a page title, section title, or card title uses Playfair. UI chrome and buttons stay Geist, and UI sans does not use weight 700 for body-scale copy.

rules.name: The Two-Layer Rule
rules.body: There are only two heights in this system: cards, and the page they sit on. Nothing nests a third. If a surface is not a card, it does not cast a shadow, and a card never contains another card.

rules.name: The Lift Confirms Rule
rules.body: Hover elevation is reserved for surfaces that actually do something when clicked. A panel that rises under the cursor but does nothing is a lie about its affordance - static panels use .card-rest, interactive cards use .card-lift.

dos: Do keep page background white (#ffffff) and body text warm ink (#1c1a18).
Do use Playfair for every headline-level title and Geist for nav, forms, and buttons.
Do reserve rose (#de718e) for hover states, decorative lines, and gradient stops, never for small white-on-rose text.
Do separate major home sections with vertical space, not alternating background colors.
Do honor reduced motion by disabling the page-entry fade when the user prefers reduced motion.
donts: Don't use navy blue anywhere; it is the retired palette (PRODUCT Hard Avoids).
Don't use pure #000000 as a full-page background; the dark hero uses the ink neutral.
Don't use cool gray borders; borders stay lavender (#beb5fa).
Don't put blue on any interactive element; failure condition per PRODUCT.
Don't add section background color changes just to separate blocks; use space.
Don't use gradients except the hero radial glow and hero bottom rule (PRODUCT).
Don't use glassmorphism (decorative blur panels) as the default chrome; the nav is opaque warm field.
Don't use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk (PRODUCT).
Don't ship layouts that look like a generic church template, AI-generated nonprofit site, or SaaS hero strip (PRODUCT Anti-Generic Directive).
Don't use decorative blobs, gradient meshes, or floating shapes behind content (PRODUCT).
